newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Pure Foods vies for Burger King franchise.
newsitem.headline: Pure Foods vies for Burger King franchise.

text.p: Philippines' Pure Foods Corp, the food subsidiary of conglomerate Ayala Corp, is negotiating for the local franchise of leading fastfood chain Burger King, company officials said on Tuesday.
"It is true that we are one of the groups negotiating for the franchise but it has not been awarded yet," a company executive, who asked not to be named, told Reuters.
Earlier, Pure Foods said it was planning to venture into fastfoods and franchising business this year to improve its foothold in the processed meat market.
Pure Foods has 50 to 60 percent of the processed meat market in the Philippines.
